posts.title: AI Open-Source Roundup — What Actually Matters Today
posts.summary: Fresh scan from Reddit + X over the last day. Short notes only: what dropped, what matters, what to try.
bullets: Agent-memory and MCP tooling keeps improving for long-context workflows.
UGC/ad-creative automation stacks are maturing, but human polish still wins.
Local-first and self-hosted AI workflows are easier for small teams now.
Best pattern: test many hooks cheaply, keep winners, mutate only top performers.
